A '''Tuskbeast pike''' was a type of two&ndash;[[Limb/Legends|handed]] [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] used by members of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Pike/Legends|pikes]] were orignally created by the Nikto to hunt the predatory [[tuskbeast]] found on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. Their hafts were traditionally made from tuskbeast [[Bone/Legends|bone]] and carved with poetry from Nikto mythology.

==Description==
Tuskbeast pikes were a type of long two&ndash;[[Limb/Legends|handed]] [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]]. The head of the [[Pike/Legends|pike]] came to a point with an attached [[Axe/Legends|axe]] blade and disc&ndash;shaped protrusion. Just above the other end of the pike there was a large ellipsoid section of the [[Melee weapon/Legends|weapon]]. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] haft was traditionally made from the [[Bone/Legends|bone]] and ivory of the [[tuskbeast]], a type of predator found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. The hafts were often also elaborately carved with sacred images and poetry from [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] mythology as well as other meaningful inscriptions.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />  

==History==
The pikes were originally developed by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in order to hunt tuskbeasts, predators found on the Nikto [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Kintan located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> Between [[920 BBY]] and [[671 BBY]],<ref name="Evocar date">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}} dates [[Direus'pei]] [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to [[920 BBY]] and [[Death/Legends|death]] to [[671 BBY]], thus the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']] must have been written between those dates.</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Author/Legends|playwright]] [[Direus'pei]] published the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']], which excoriated the [[Hutt Empire]]'s use of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] and inspired various client species of the empire to revolution including the Nikto. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Nikto warriors chiseled dialogue from Evocar on their tuskbeast pikes.<ref name="Xim Week 4" /> By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Rebel Date">Scenarios in ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' take place while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] is active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the alliance was created in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] thus the [[tuskbeast]] must be extinct by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> many Nikto still carried the pikes even though the tuskbeasts were extinct. Tuskbeast pikes sold for 1050 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during this time.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tuskbeast pikes were first mentioned in the fourth part of [[Michael Kogge]]'s article series ''[[Xim Week: The Despotica]]'', which was published as an exclusive article on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']] on [[December 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Xim Week 4" /> They were first pictured in ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]]. In the supplement, the pike has a rarity of eight out of ten,<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> which indicated that the weapon was difficult for players to find on the average world.<ref name="Edge of the Empire">''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''</ref>
